system.description: An increasingly frequent occurrence among Cappadocians is a strange accentuation of their inherent clan weakness. Numerous Cappadocians, already prone to resembling walking corpses, have shown a more pronounced Horrific Appearance: their skin draws tight over their bones and scales away entirely in patches. Advanced cases may exhibit open sores, excessive decomposition of the body, limbs and head (commonly resulting in the loss of the nose and ears), and a repulsive scent reminiscent of the grave. Cappadocians suffering this Flaw are treated as having no Appearance Traits for Social Challenges where their appearance is visible; this can never be improved, though it may be physically hidden or masked with magic or Disciplines.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
